<think>**Selecting one-hot architecture**

**Choosing explicit one-hot mux**

</think>

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module mux_large (
    input [7:0] block_a, block_b, block_c, block_d, block_e,
    input [7:0] block_f, block_g, block_h, block_i, block_j,
    input [3:0] sel,
    output reg [7:0] block_out
);
    wire en_a, en_b, en_c, en_d, en_e;
    wire en_f, en_g, en_h, en_i, en_j;

    assign en_a = (~|sel) | (sel[3] & (sel[2] | sel[1]));
    assign en_b = (sel == 4'd1);
    assign en_c = (sel == 4'd2);
    assign en_d = (sel == 4'd3);
    assign en_e = (sel == 4'd4);
    assign en_f = (sel == 4'd5);
    assign en_g = (sel == 4'd6);
    assign en_h = (sel == 4'd7);
    assign en_i = (sel == 4'd8);
    assign en_j = (sel == 4'd9);

    always @* begin
        block_out = ({8{en_a}} & block_a)
                  | ({8{en_b}} & block_b)
                  | ({8{en_c}} & block_c)
                  | ({8{en_d}} & block_d)
                  | ({8{en_e}} & block_e)
                  | ({8{en_f}} & block_f)
                  | ({8{en_g}} & block_g)
                  | ({8{en_h}} & block_h)
                  | ({8{en_i}} & block_i)
                  | ({8{en_j}} & block_j);
    end
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline select-to-output path includes shared decode buffering and several output-combination stages, ending in an O21AI cell. Default handling can introduce an additional selection layer.",
  "rewrite": "Express the complete function as ten mutually exclusive data masks followed by an OR reduction. Fold selectors 0 and 10 through 15 directly into block_a's enable, avoiding a separate default-data mux. The other enables select blocks b through j for selectors 1 through 9.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The flatter masked-data network is intended to shorten the select-to-output path relative to the 1.04 ns baseline. A numerical gain is not established without mapping and STA; decoder fanout and ABC factoring will determine the result.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Uses shared select decoding and 80 single-bit data-mask terms. This may trade output-network area against reduced mux depth. Compliance with the 1006.089920 um^2 cap and zero electrical violations requires evaluation in the specified flow; neither has been measured here.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For every two-state input, selectors 0 through 9 return block_a through block_j respectively, and selectors 10 through 15 return block_a. Exactly one enable is asserted for every two-state selector. The module name, ports, unsigned widths, and combinational behavior are unchanged. No parameters, clocks, storage, latency, assumptions, includes, or dependencies are introduced."
}
